limits: Native combined acceptance is macOS arm64 with Ghidra 12.1.2/Java 21/Node 24; earlier selected headless Windows/Linux evidence remains at its own source identity.
Owned synthetic static PE/ELF inputs and separately owned host-native debugger executables; not execution of every imported EXE format.
Representative known-value/result/failure variants, not every SDK overload or input combination. The larger saved fixture checks 32 MiB initialized memory, 20000 symbols and 1000 types.
Manual merge/refresh by default; opt-in synchronization uses the same conflict rules. Complex divergent categories without a proved merge rule retain both versions.
Unknown publication blocks the shared target lane until independent history/saved-state verification; no blind retry or force replacement.
Saved debugger state can reopen disconnected; crashed CPU execution is not resurrected. External effects have their own outcomes.
Archive integration uses an owned contract-service fixture; external-service development/deployment is excluded.
No npm publication, production migration or capacity guarantee for arbitrary production databases.
